summary: Completed testing of IST timezone fixes, late detection logic, and leave-blocking on check-in. All 13 backend tests passed (2 skipped due to no records). Frontend verification confirmed: shift config shows 10:00 (from business policy), Late badges display correctly with orange styling, Present rows don't have leave_type, On Leave rows don't have Late badge, HR action buttons visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IST timezone fixes verified working. Key findings: 1) Shift config from business policy shows 10:00-19:00 (not hardcoded 9AM). 2) Late detection uses IST - check-ins before 10:00 IST are NOT late, check-ins after 10:15 IST ARE late. 3) Late badges display with orange styling (e.g., '310m' for 310 minutes late). 4) Present rows correctly don't show leave_type. 5) On Leave rows correctly don't show Late badge. 6) Check-in blocked if approved leave exists (returns 400 with message). 7) Regularization recalculates late status using IST. 8) HR action buttons (inline edit, regularize) visible for admin users.
